definitions.full: H2241. Zetham זֵתָם proper name, masculine (sub זית in Thes, = foregoing) — a Levite (Gershonite) 1Chr 23:8 , apparently son of לַעְדָּן and brother of יְחִיאֵל and יוֺאֵל ; 26:22 apparently grandson of לַעְדָּן , and son of יְחִיאֵלִי (expressly called brother of יוֺאֵל ); ᵐ5 Ζεθομ , Ζοθομ , ᵐ5 L Ζηθαν . זַךְ זָךְ, , see below זכך . below זֵתָם proper name, masculine a Levite 1Chr 23:8 ; 26:28 .

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, Zetham, and Joel, three.
The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of Yahweh’s house.
